item.text: The default workspace and temp locations didn’t show the new file, so I’m checking the built-in image generation output directory directly.
I found the generated PNG in the built-in output directory. I’m copying that exact file to the requested final path and writing the receipt from the copied PNG.

item.command:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "src='/home/graham/.codex/generated_images/019f2fbb-8f80-7e32-88a9-dab5710d5360/ig_00e3fbebef2af163016a49a8f022c88193bbb5fc253447fbb3.png'
out='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/persona-dream/reports/pipeline-complete/phase_07_storyboard_live_tau/panel_001_live_scillm.png'
receipt='/home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills/skills/persona-dream/reports/pipeline-complete/phase_07_storyboard_live_tau/tau-run-vlm/command-loop/command-artifacts/command-loop-step-001/scillm_image_generation_receipt.json'
mkdir -p \""'$(dirname "$out")" "$(dirname "$receipt")"
cp "$src" "$out"
read width height < <(identify -format '"'%w %h' \""'$out")
sha=$(sha256sum "$out" | awk '"'{print "'$1}'"')
printf '{\\n  \"ok\": true,\\n  \"auth\": \"codex_oauth_image_gen\",\\n  \"path\": \"%s\",\\n  \"width\": %s,\\n  \"height\": %s,\\n  \"sha256\": \"%s\"\\n}\\n' \""'$out" "$width" "$height" "$sha" > "$receipt"
test -s "$out" && test -s "$receipt"
ls -l "$out" "$receipt"
printf '"'\\nreceipt:\\n'
sed -n '1,120p' \""'$receipt"'
